name: Turn an AI feature or assistant on or off
definition: Master and per-feature AI switches, opt-in before first use, uninstalling AI, admin enablement of AI features.

name: Stop wake words and always-on listening
definition: Wake words, lock-screen or button invocation, push-to-talk, background voice.

name: Stop proactive suggestions and background AI
definition: AI that runs or surfaces content without being asked: daily briefs, nudges, suggestion cards, auto web search, background summaries.

name: Do not keep what I submit
definition: Temporary or incognito chats, zero data retention, store=false, no-save options for inputs and outputs.

name: Filter or mask sensitive data
definition: PII masking and redaction, sensitive-data filters, keeping sensitive topics out of stored data.

name: Limit device sensors and permissions
definition: Location, microphone, camera, screen sharing, contacts and health permissions.

name: Limit usage telemetry and diagnostics
definition: Usage metrics, error and crash reports, diagnostic data, customer experience programs.

name: Limit screen and activity capture
definition: Screen snapshots, computer or browsing activity capture, use of open tabs or played media as context.

name: Limit logs and traces of agent and model activity
definition: Audit logs, traces, action recordings, request/response logging and what those records contain.

name: Set how long data is kept
definition: Auto-delete windows, retention periods, TTLs and expiry settings.

name: Opt out of ad personalization
definition: Personalized ads, ads based on chats or activity, cross-app tracking permission, ad-network opt-outs.

name: Turn off or limit memory
definition: Saving or using memories, referencing past chats, project-scoped memory, correcting what is remembered.

name: Turn off personalization from other data
definition: Personalization from instructions, other products, connected apps, device use or profiling services.

name: Opt out of sale or sharing for ads, incl. GPC
definition: Legal 'do not sell or share' opt-outs, targeted-advertising opt-outs and GPC.

name: Refuse non-essential cookies on vendor websites
definition: Cookie banners and preference centers for analytics, marketing and targeting cookies.

name: Opt out of analytics, feedback and product improvement
definition: Use of data for analytics or product improvement other than model training; feedback prompts and sharing.

name: Opt out of model training
definition: Training on chats, voice, connected-app data or feedback; training data-sharing programs and objections.

name: Control which connectors and third parties receive data
definition: Connecting, disconnecting or toggling apps, plugins and extensions; routing data to outside models or partners.

name: Control public sharing of chats and outputs
definition: Shared links, public posts and published models or templates that let a chat or output travel beyond the user.

name: Opt out of human review
definition: Abuse monitoring logging, staff access to content, review of recordings, records of human access.

name: Revoke an agent's access and clear its working state
definition: Remove an agent from a space, revoke its access to accounts, devices or sites, cancel a delegation, delete its stored sign-ins and sessions.

name: Pause or delete scheduled and background agent tasks
definition: Pause, cancel or delete scheduled tasks, routines and automations; stop an agent resuming or continuing work on its own.

name: Limit which apps, sites, files and networks an agent can reach
definition: Tool and MCP server allowlists, site blocklists, per-app or per-folder access, network egress limits, OAuth scopes.

name: Require approval before agent actions
definition: Approval modes, per-action approval prompts, confirmations before consequential actions, human-in-the-loop, take over, spending blocks.

name: Choose where data is processed or stored
definition: Data residency, on-device or self-hosted processing, customer-owned storage.

name: Delete data
definition: Deleting chats, memories, recordings, files or accounts.

name: Request privacy rights from the vendor
definition: Access, objection, restriction, consent withdrawal and similar requests under privacy law.

name: Opt out of marketing communications
definition: Marketing email, call and message opt-outs.

name: Export data
definition: Data export and portability.

name: Content safety, parental and age controls
definition: Content filters and guardrails, parental controls, age verification.

name: Admin access, security and release governance
definition: Roles, access control, rate limits, encryption, release approvals and compliance settings.

name: Other
definition: Attribution, sync, plan changes, account termination and other controls.
